Iris (platform): FYI I'm proposing a guarded 'flag housekeeping' pipeline to delete long-unused runtime flags. Plan: preview -> canary -> cohorted apply -> finalize. Need safety checks.
Marco (runtime): Nice. What qualifies as "long-unused"?
Iris (platform): candidate = `deprecated:true` AND `last_used_ts < now-90d` AND NOT `safety:critical`. Default skip if `owner` missing.
Zoe (infra): exclude infra-control flags by default (eg lb, rollout-keys). Also we should tag region-scoped flags and skip unless owner consents.
Theo (ops): ops wishlist: dry-run preview per-service, canary in shadow-store for 1h, cohort percentages (10/50/100), metric gates and snapshots for rollback. Manual review if >4 removals/service.
Iris (platform): API sketch (internal-only): POST /v1/internal/configs/housekeeping {"dry_run":true, "services":[], "cohort_pct":10, "owners_override":false} and GET /v1/internal/configs/housekeeping/{id}/preview
Marco (runtime): runtime will add `is_housekeeping_candidate(flag)` predicate and a bulk-owners lookup to avoid N calls. We'll snapshot pre-change state to housekeeping_snapshot_{id}.json and retain 30d.
Zoe (infra): I'll expose `/v1/flags/bulk-owners?names=...` returning name, owners, region_scope, and rate-limit headers. Region-scoped flags get flagged in the preview UI.
Theo (ops): metric gates: error_rate delta (1m/5m), p95 delta, and 5xx rate. Thresholds: error_rate +1% OR p95 +50ms OR 5xx +0.5% -> auto-pause and rollback to snapshot.
Iris (platform): Console UX: preview diffs with owner badges, per-flag metadata, a bulk-approve checkbox per service, and an EMERGENCY PAUSE button that flips `housekeeping.pause=true`. Provide permalink to the dry-run JSON for audit.
Marco (runtime): Shadow-store option: apply removals to a shadow namespace and run 1h of real traffic. If clean, proceed to cohorts. Keeps rollback cheap. Make shadow opt-in for initial runs.
Zoe (infra): Ownership-missing flow: send a slack ping to `#ownerless-flags` with preview link and skip by default. owners_override=true requires 2 approvers recorded in the API call.
Theo (ops): Rollback API: POST /v1/internal/configs/housekeeping/{id}/rollback to restore snapshot. Also require runbook entries for emergency contact and who can flip pause.
Iris (platform): Telemetry events: housekeeping.preview, housekeeping.cohort.apply, housekeeping.finalize, housekeeping.rollback. Each event includes counts, service, sweep_id, operator_id, and pre/post metric snapshots.
Marco (runtime): Implementation note: only delete if `last_used_ts` older than 90d and deprecated. For extra safety, add a `min_flag_count` check so we don't remove large bundles at once.
Zoe (infra): Edge-case: flags present only in a specific region should be surfaced with region usage and require explicit owner consent. Bulk-owners will annotate `region_scope`.
Theo (ops): For approval UX: require explicit typed confirmation when approving >10 removals across org. Also record approver IDs in audit.

Iris (platform): Great. I'll write a short RFC+console mock and tag infra/ops for metrics list by EOD. Sync on standup tomorrow. :thumbsup:
